notes: πᾶν is rightly kept separate from οὐδέποτε: the ASV writes 'never … anything', two English words with the indefinite rendered non-negatively, so rule 87's joining case does not arise and rule 69's reasoning leaves the negation on the adverb.
Μηδαμῶς → 'Not so' headed on the negative word; κοινόν takes its supplied relativizer and copula as rule 7/9 helpers.
